description: Window Jitter Fix - Hide new tiling windows offscreen immediately, then reveal at correct position during layout

userStories.title: Extract optimal corner calculation helper
userStories.description: As a developer, I need a reusable function to compute the optimal hide corner for each monitor so I don't duplicate the multi-monitor corner logic.
acceptanceCriteria: Extract `computeMonitorToOptimalHideCorner(monitors:) -> [CGPoint: OptimalHideCorner]` from `layoutWorkspaces()` in Sources/AppBundle/layout/refresh.swift
Function is pure and reusable from multiple call sites
`layoutWorkspaces()` uses the extracted helper with no behavior change
Typecheck passes (`./build-debug.sh`)
Existing tests pass (`./run-tests.sh`)

userStories.title: Hide new tiling windows immediately on registration
userStories.description: As a user, I want new tiling windows to be hidden offscreen immediately so I don't see them at the default macOS position.
acceptanceCriteria: In `MacWindow.getOrRegister` (Sources/AppBundle/tree/MacWindow.swift), after binding window to tree and before returning, check if window is tiling
If window parent is `TilingContainer` or `rootTilingContainer` AND workspace is visible, call `hideInCorner()` immediately
Use `computeMonitorToOptimalHideCorner` to select the optimal corner
Window is hidden before `tryOnWindowDetected` callbacks run
Typecheck passes (`./build-debug.sh`)
userStories.notes: Check parent.cases for .tilingContainer to determine if window is tiling

userStories.title: Skip hiding for popup and dialog windows
userStories.description: As a user, I want popup and dialog windows to open at their natural macOS position without being hidden.
acceptanceCriteria: Popup windows (parent is `macosPopupWindowsContainer`) are NOT hidden
Dialog windows (parent is workspace directly) are NOT hidden
Only windows with parent `TilingContainer` are hidden
Typecheck passes (`./build-debug.sh`)
userStories.notes: This is part of the condition in US-002 but explicitly verified

userStories.title: Skip hiding for windows on invisible workspaces
userStories.description: As a developer, I need to avoid double-hiding windows that are already on invisible workspaces.
acceptanceCriteria: Only hide windows when `workspace.isVisible` is true
Windows on invisible workspaces are handled by existing `layoutWorkspaces()` hide logic
No redundant `hideInCorner` calls
Typecheck passes (`./build-debug.sh`)

userStories.title: Verify existing layout handles reveal correctly
userStories.description: As a user, I want hidden windows to appear at their correct tiled position when layout runs.
acceptanceCriteria: Existing `layoutWorkspaces()` flow handles unhiding automatically via `unhideFromCorner()`
`layoutRecursive` sets correct frame, overwriting the hidden position
No additional code needed in layout path - verify existing behavior works
Manually test: open a new tiling window and confirm it appears at correct position without jitter
Typecheck passes (`./build-debug.sh`)
userStories.notes: This story is mostly verification that existing code works with the new hide call

userStories.title: Test multi-monitor corner selection
userStories.description: As a user with multiple monitors, I want new windows to be hidden in the optimal corner that doesn't overlap with other monitors.
acceptanceCriteria: Windows hidden in bottom-left if bottom-right overlaps another monitor
Windows hidden in bottom-right otherwise (default)
Test with 2+ monitors using DeskPad or BetterDisplay 2
No window briefly visible at wrong position on any monitor
Typecheck passes (`./build-debug.sh`)
userStories.notes: Manual testing required with virtual monitors
